description: This file defines the ImportMapOutlook class which extends ImportMapOther, managing import settings related to Outlook files in the SuiteCRM project. It specifies properties like delimiter, enclosure, header presence, and includes a method for module-specific field mappings.

classes.name: ImportMapOutlook
classes.description: A class managing import settings specific to Outlook files for SuiteCRM, extending ImportMapOther and providing custom mappings for modules.

methods.name: getMapping
methods.description: Returns field mappings for a specified module, adding Outlook-specific mappings for 'Contacts' and 'Leads'.
